QuestInfo.name: Whispers of the Heart
QuestInfo.0: Memories of the past are fickle things. Some bring great joy, and others sadness. Some can't help but do both. This is a story of the undying sort. How will you feel, when all's said and done? \r\nFind out in Masque's first story!
